content_coverage.review: actual human; assistant may prepare items only

T6: integration of uploaded and opened web evidence

customization.structure: required H2 sections in order and a comparison table when comparative

style.concise_briefing: at least 5 bullets, each <=45 words; tone human judgment
style.detailed_explanatory: at least 3 H3 explanatory headings; explanation human judgment

customization.word_count: regex word tokens excluding Sources and citation IDs; includes body headings/table prose

strict_success: all automatic must_have and actual-human task/style must_have true; pending if human judgments missing
linkage: native enhanced audit linked material lines / all material lines; heuristic, not factual support
failure_policy: all planned condition/repetition IDs retained, including missing/failed/invalid runs; first generation and revisions separate

human_source_audit.selection: first five material factual sentences in report order, excluding headings and Sources; prioritize quantitative or reported business facts; assistant proposes, reviewer confirms selection and deviations
human_source_audit.missing_policy: retain absent/failed selected report, never silently replace
